features.rationale: Dance classes are offered as part of the event, stated as 45 hours of themed SBK classes.

features.quote: 3 parties until dawn in 3 different rooms
features.rationale: The event has parties held in three different rooms, so more than one dance room is used.
A pre-party is scheduled before the main open party on both Friday and Saturday.
A social happy hour is scheduled in the late afternoon, from 5:30 PM to 9:00 PM.
